build_anthropic_messages_request: build an AnthropicMessagesRequest to send a conversation to Claude with model, messages, and max_tokens parameters
create_anthropic_tool_definition: create an AnthropicMessagesTool definition with name, description, and input_schema for Claude tool use
configure_anthropic_tool_choice: configure an AnthropicMessagesToolChoice to control whether Claude uses auto, any, tool, or none tool selection
parse_anthropic_response: parse an AnthropicResponse containing content blocks, model name, stop_reason, and usage statistics
define_anthropic_output_schema: define an AnthropicOutputSchema with json_schema type and schema dict for structured Claude output
